answer_1.quote: We conduct the first largescale study on provider bias in seven state-of-the-art (SOTA) LLMs for code generation ... we construct a dataset comprising 17,014 input prompts ... focusing on Python code snippets (and Java for translation tasks).
datasets: 17,014 input prompts covering 6 coding task categories and 30 scenarios

answer_2.quote: We implement two metrics to evaluate and measure LLM provider bias... Gini Index (GI)... Modification Ratio (MR)...

answer_4.quote: We conduct IRB-approved human studies with two parts involving 50 participants... Part 1 focuses on assessing the concealment of service modifications... Part 2 aims to understand users' feedback when they become aware of LLM's service modifications.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to (1) judge whether the LLM response follows the prompt, (2) assess if the service modification was necessary, (3) evaluate whether it undermines user decision autonomy, and (4) indicate if it degrades user experience.
